description: Read-only query and diagnosis of Alibaba Cloud ActionTrail operation audit events: find out who performed which operation, when, from which source IP, and on which resource, across one or many regions, rendered as a 12-column event table or machine-readable JSON. Use when the user asks about the audit log or operation history of an Alibaba Cloud account; wants to know who changed, created, deleted, or operated on a resource; asks when a resource was operated on; needs to trace read/write operation records, console sign-ins, or API calls of a cloud service; or wants to investigate suspicious or failed operations recorded by ActionTrail. Triggers: audit log, operation history, operation records, who changed, who operated, who deleted, when was it operated, action history, read/write operations, ActionTrail, audit event, operation trace.
